summary: SIEM feed s069_single is degraded due to 9.3% duplicate packets (166/1784) exceeding 5% threshold. No packet drops, overload, one-way, VLAN or encryption issues detected. Traffic is complete but not clean.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker is forwarding the same packets twice without deduplication - typically caused by aggregating two SPAN/mirror sessions covering the same traffic or feeding both sides of a TAP into one tool port without dedup enabled.
findings.impact_on_tool: SIEM wastes ingest/license and storage on 9.3% duplicate events, inflates counts and can create duplicate alerts/correlations and skewed analytics, reducing detection efficiency even though SIEM does not require full payload or bidirectional flows.

recommended_fix.why: Enable packet-broker deduplication (header-hash, ~10ms window) on the SIEM feed to drop identical packets arriving via multiple paths before delivery, eliminating duplicates without losing unique traffic.
